verdict.rationale: WezTerm's shell integration docs show command-aware features: jumping through scrollback to the start of an earlier command, selecting a command's complete output, and OSC 7 working-directory tracking that can drive tab titles or the status area. The specific capabilities the story names (exit status, duration, notifications) are not evidenced. missing for 10: exit-status display, command duration tracking, notifications when long-running commands finish, independent corroboration of shell-integration features.
